summary_verdict: V6.1 SEED 37184 FAILS — DO NOT GENERATE 37185

issue_1_cross_district_routing_deficit.diagnosis: In V6.1, 71.07% of cases cross district boundaries. In these cross-district cases, district Top-1 accuracy was 30.54% (just barely passing the 30% gate). While local cases achieved 64.96% accuracy, the high volume of cross-district cases pulled overall district Top-1 down to 40.71% (below the 45% gate).
issue_1_cross_district_routing_deficit.mechanism: District transition weights in Stage 1 were formed by independent additive terms for dominant_account_district, terminal_mule_district, and victim_district, without cross-district route coherence. When intermediate and terminal districts diverge, the model assigns scattered probability masses without directional consensus.
issue_1_cross_district_routing_deficit.redesign_requirement: Implement cross-district route coherence and multi-channel evidence consensus in Stage 1, giving cross-district routing a design headroom of >= 37% without artificially collapsing cross-district case frequency.

issue_2_conditional_vs_marginal_divergen.diagnosis: V6.1 exhibited a sharp contradiction between conditional dispersion and marginal concentration: conditional cluster choices were too diffuse (dominant cluster within recurring signatures was only 27.70% vs target 35-50%), while global cluster choices experienced mode collapse (Connaught Place captured 7.28% globally vs cap 5.0%, and marketplace fraud concentrated 19.11% into Seelampur vs cap 15.0%).
issue_2_conditional_vs_marginal_divergen.mechanism: Global hub attractiveness (such as COMMERCIAL_HUB_CLUSTER_IDS and TRANSPORT_HUB_CLUSTER_IDS) was defined across the entire city rather than per district. Whenever an archetype preferred a commercial or transit role, it overwhelmingly chose the same 1-2 famous hubs (Cluster 7 Connaught Place, Cluster 66 Seelampur) regardless of the local context.
issue_2_conditional_vs_marginal_divergen.redesign_requirement: Replace global hub lists with district-local cluster portfolios. Every district must possess its own commercial, transport, ATM-heavy, and branch clusters. Sub-prototypes and fraud types will map to functional roles rather than specific global cluster IDs.

policy_conclusions.seed_37184_policy: Seed 37184 is consumed. It must never be reused for parameter tuning or benchmark re-runs.
